reddit.title: Improving Audio Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! No more abrupt transitions in music during gameplay. Our new system features a long equal-power crossfade that creates a seamless listening experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
